metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Hip and Leg Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve hip and leg pain.

These exercises are going to focus on the main muscles that cause pain in this area, including the glutes, piriformis and hip flexors. 

Each exercise works a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief. 

Let us know what works for you!
